title: ethLive
tagline: Decentralized streaming platform, allowing content creators and users to interact directly.
description: Our project is aimed at giving content creators across the web more control over their content. Our decentralized streaming platform gives streamers full control over their monetization, including features for decentralized subscriptions, donations, and selling or giving away NFTs. This allows their audience to engage with them without middlemen and without old-fashioned community guidelines.
how_its_made:
LiveEth uses a front end made in Angular, Livepeer for the transmissions, we're implementing Zora to get real-time data about streamers' NFTs and special benefits that come for the chat from owning them, and NFT storage to store this benefits, that could be, among other things, clips from the stream, emoji packs, or custom images. All of this is in Polygon. 

We're missing a couple of web2 features, like a functional chat, which we're planning on implement using nodeJS, and the streamers list, etc. which we are going to consume on an API made in Django with PostgreSQL, hosted on an AWS server.
